info.title: AnotherMe Gateway API
info.description:
Unified backend gateway for AnotherMe Web and Mobile clients.

Capabilities follow the registry defined in `agents/foundation/capability_registry.py`.
Valid capability ids: `course_generate`, `problem_video_generate`, `quiz_practice`,
`interactive_demo`, `ai_tutor_chat`, `deep_solve`, `deep_research`,
`math_animator`, `visualize`, `co_writer`.

P1 changes:
  - Capability endpoints (P0-3) are now wired.
  - Global error envelope (`{ error_code, message, request_id, details? }`).
  - Live-book / co-writer / courses routes are first-class.

Auth: Phase 0 uses static `Bearer <GATEWAY_API_TOKEN>`. Phase 2 will switch to Supabase JWT.

bearerAuth.description: Phase 0: static token from GATEWAY_API_TOKEN env var. Phase 2: Supabase JWT.

capability.description: One of: ai_tutor_chat, deep_solve, deep_research, course_generate, problem_video_generate, math_animator, visualize, co_writer, quiz_practice, interactive_demo

request_id.description: Echoed from X-Request-Id header, or auto-minted.

Error.description: Error envelope (unified across all routes since P1)
